trail.text: Order-service disk activity looks anomalous — digging deeper to confirm if it's the source of the cascade.

causes.reasoning: Disk IO spikes 10x at 0-40s (earliest exceed at 11s) with DB query p95s jumping 10x, and all latencies (seat, security, inside-payment, preserve) are its direct callers.
Preserve latency jumps 0.95 to 2.15s from 20s onward with POST preserve p50 doubling, but it calls order/security/seat so is a victim aggregating downstream delay.
Security latency jumps 0.08 to 0.46s from 31s with securityConfigs p95 61ms to 473ms; it calls order-service and is called by preserve, marking it as victim propagator.
Seat latency rises from 25s with POST p95 26ms to 215ms and it calls order-service while being called by preserve, consistent with victim of order slowness.
Inside-payment latency rises earliest among callers at 21s (0.08 to 0.22s mean, 0.43 peak) and it calls order-service, indicating victim of order-service degradation.
